recipes.name: Land Octopus inspired by Elden Ring
ingredients: To taste pine bud cone syrup
instructions: For the Grilled Land Octopus
Soak dried lily flowers in hot water for 30 minutes. - ⅓ cup dried lily flowers
Meanwhile, bring a large dutch oven filled ⅔ of the way full with water to a boil, preferably over an open fire.
Using a cleaver or large knife separate the legs from the head of the octopus. - 1 (4 6lb) octopus beak + eyes removed

Cut off the stem portion of the soaked lily flowers and add them to the boiling water along with the octopus legs, onion, ginger, nettles, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns, red dates, and salt. - 1 inch fresh ginger sliced - ¼ cup dried nettles - 3 cloves garlic - 2 bay leaves - 2 tsp black peppercorns - 3 ½ red dates - 1 tbsp kosher salt
Cook for octopus until fork tender for 45 minutes - 1 hour.
Once cooked, remove the octopus legs from the pot. Pat the legs dry and brush them with olive oil. Skewer the legs using heavy duty grilling skewers.
Grill the octopus for 3-5 minutes per side or until well charred over an open fire or grill. - As needed cooking olive oil
Plate the octopus as desired and serve with Chili Oil and sprinkle with finishing salt. - Simple Chili Oil (see recipe below) - As needed finishing salt
For the Simple Chili Oil
Add the chili flakes to a medium heat-proof bowl. - ⅓ cup chili flakes
Add the oil to a medium pot. Heat the oil over high heat until it reaches 325°F. - 1 cup neutral oil
Add the garlic, ginger, and shallot to the pot and cook until crisp, about 2-3 minutes. - 8 cloves garlic sliced - 1 inch ginger peeled + sliced - 1 shallot minced
Pour the hot oil over the chili flakes, be careful as the mixture will bubble aggressively, and allow it to cool at room temperature.
Once cooled, transfer the mixture to a sealed container and store until ready to use. Optionally, blend the cooled chili oil in a food processor for a more intense heat.
For the Crimson Tears Tea
Line a pour-over funnel with cheesecloth or a coffee filter.
Add the flowers and soursop leaves to the pourover glass, then add the hot water. - ¼ cup Hibiscus flowers - 2 ½ Soursop leaves - 2 cup hot water (~190°F)
Allow the mixture to steep for 5 minutes. Then pour the strained tea into the serving glass of choice.
Optionally, sweeten the tea to taste with pine bud cone syrup. - To taste pine bud cone syrup
